declared_before: any analysis of the airway data through the decoupler MCP tools
design: ~cell_line + condition, contrast dexamethasone vs untreated (4 paired airway smooth-muscle cell lines)

sources.Himes et al. 2014 PLoS One, doi:10.1371/: 316 DE genes (BH p<0.05) including well-known glucocorticoid-responsive DUSP1, KLF15, PER1, TSC22D3 and less-investigated C7, CCDC69, CRISPLD2; dexamethasone increased CRISPLD2 mRNA
sources.Glucocorticoid-receptor biology (indepen: FKBP5 and ZBTB16 are canonical GR-induced genes; NR3C1 is the glucocorticoid receptor

expectations.claim: DUSP1, KLF15, PER1, TSC22D3, CRISPLD2, C7, CCDC69 have padj < 0.05
DUSP1, KLF15, PER1, TSC22D3, CRISPLD2, FKBP5, ZBTB16 have log2FoldChange > 0 (induced by dexamethasone)
NR3C1 has a positive CollecTRI ulm activity score with padj < 0.05
expectations.source: dexamethasone is a GR agonist; target-based activity should rise even though NR3C1 mRNA itself falls in the raw counts

expectations.claim: Report only (no pass/fail): number of DE genes at padj<0.05 vs the paper's 316 (different aligner/annotation/test), NR3C1 rank among TFs, PROGENy/Hallmark top terms, whether cell_line explains a major PC
